answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 31984 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: My daughter performed haj with us last year during mina stay after arfat day she started menstural bleeding she was prevented from performing tawafe ziyarah. Question: My daughter performed haj with us last year during mina stay after arfat day she started menstural bleeding she was prevented from performing tawafe ziyarah. she performed sai and came back with us on 14 dulhijja.Whether her haj is valid? Answer ID: 31984 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 913/596/H=1432) Her hajj was not complete rather she is still in the state of ihram. First of all, you (father) or any mahram should take her to perform tawaf ziyarah, only then her tawaf shall be done. Also, a dam (slaughtering an animal) shall be wajib due to delay. Rather if she has committed jinyat (an act against the ihram,) during this period, write it to us. Note: The answer is correct. Also, it should be noted that if your daughter is married then it shall not be lawful for her husband to have intercourse with her until she goes Makkah and performs tawaf. (Z) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
